name: camera3d
summary: 3D viewport camera. Required for any 3D scene to render — at least one Camera3D with current=true. Use for first-person, third-person, orbit (chain_render_wall.gd auto-orbits a Camera3D around the tile grid), or fixed-angle views. Supports perspective or orthogonal projection. fov is vertical field of view in degrees (75 default ≈ standard 35mm photography); near/far clip planes define the visible depth range. Set current=true to make this the active camera; only one current Camera3D per viewport.
example_tscn_snippet:
[node name="MyCam" type="Camera3D" parent="."]
transform = Transform3D(1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 2, 8)
fov = 70.0
near = 0.1
far = 200.0
current = true
